# Customer Response Assistant — Aurics.AI

> Internal AI-native tool that drafts on-brand customer responses aligned with approved messaging. Paste a customer communication, choose an organization and rating, and get a publish-ready reply.

## Pages

- [Customer Response Assistant](/): Generate on-brand responses for customer reviews, emails, feedback, and support communications.
- [Positive Feedback Examples](/guides/positive-feedback): Copy-paste response templates and a guide to replying to positive customer reviews with brand loyalty in mind.

## Optional

- [Aurics.AI](https://aurics.ai): Visit the AI-Native GTM Studio behind this tool.
